semiconductor_relevance: High — United Silicon Innovation Corp. specializes in silicon test wafers and related products, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: United Silicon Innovation Corp. (USIC) is a leading provider of silicon test wafers, offering a comprehensive range of products including monitor wafers, dummy wafers, and reclaim services. Their solutions are utilized by tier one semiconductor manufacturers and various industry segments for process control, equipment acceptance, and as substrates for advanced packaging.
capabilities: Silicon-on-insulator (SOI) wafers for MEMS and power IC applications
